page.overview:
Who is Ermes Costello?

Alicia Barragán [https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=81139 Tatiane Keplmair] |race = |imgtabs=|engname=|alias=|religion=|occupation=|genre=|tvshow=|womantype=|dislikes=|goals=Find and kill Sports Maxx to avenge her sister Gloria Costello|affiliation=|liveactor=|website=|Species=Human(possible rock human)|birthday=~1987|prisonerte=Eight years in Green Dolphin Street Prison|charges=Armed robberies}}

Ermes is a woman voluntarily imprisoned in Green Dolphin Street Prison in order to seek revenge for her sister Gloria Costello's killer, Sports Maxx, and soon allies herself with Jolyne Cujoh in the hostile environment that the jail is. Thanks to a certain pendant, Ermes acquires a Stand, Kiss.

Ermes is a woman of above-average height and a fit, medium build.

She wears her hair in braided locks and multiple barrettes and has long, triangular scars approaching her eyes and lips on her forehead and chin.
